text: Autonomous organization of education Nazarbayev University Approving body: Managing Council Rules for access and internal security regime in the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” Date of approval: 12.06.2018 Date of entering into force 01.09.2018 Decision/Minutes No.: No. 12.06.18 Bylaw classification: 1.12. Safety and labour protection Initiator: Alibek Abdullayev, Senior Manager of Campus Security Service Related documents Vehicle traffic and car park regulations in the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” 1.General provisions 1. These Rules for access and inside operations mode in the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter – the Rules) specifying access and inside modes procedures

operations mode in the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter – the Rules) specifying access and inside modes procedures within the territory of the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter – the University) are mandatory for students, tenants, employees and visitors of the University. 2. Organization of access and inside modes observation work, as well as firefighting and material assets safety shall be assigned to relevant heads of University structural divisions and organizations. 3. These Rules use the following terms, definitions and abbreviations: 1) Access mode – a set of rules, actions and procedures specifying access for persons

following terms, definitions and abbreviations: 1) Access mode – a set of rules, actions and procedures specifying access for persons and vehicles, their movement within University objects and territory, as well as regulating procedure of material assets and property transfer (importation and carrying over) among objects. Access mode in University building shall be 24/7; 2) Inside security regime - a set of organizational and technical events and rules aimed at ensuring safety of students, tenants and employees of the University, fulfillment of specified internal labor policy; 3) Permit documents - documents to the right for permanent and temporary visiting University

fulfillment of specified internal labor policy; 3) Permit documents - documents to the right for permanent and temporary visiting University premises or import/export material assets provided to persons stipulated in Annex 1 hereto; 4) ID-card – a personal electronic (magnet) card ensuring access to University territory, facilities and buildings as per stipulated access categories, as well as ensuring accounting for movements of persons indicated in Annex 1 hereto. 5) ACS - an access control service, ensuring control over access mode within University territory; 6) ACP - an access control point, ensuring control over entrance/leave and access from/to the University territory;

within University territory; 6) ACP - an access control point, ensuring control over entrance/leave and access from/to the University territory; 7) TAMS – targeted access management system; 8) MA – material assets; 9) Point – an access point at entrances/exits at non -residential and residential premises of the University; 10) Secured premises – limited access premises due to the specificity of their activity performed within the specified premises. 11) Block manager – an employee of the Entity who is a materially responsible person for the fixed assets and commodity -material assets located in the Block under his/her management. 4. University territory, covered by present Rules, includes residential and non - residential premises within University Campus, as well as non -residential buildings outside University Campus, which are owned by the University. 5. Secured premises shall include server rooms, precursor warehouses, laboratories, archives, ventilation premises (well -holes), elevators, water supply rooms, heating rooms, power stations etc. 2. to implement present Rules: 1) working body is a University entity University Service Management (hereinafter – Entity); 2) Control body is University structural division – Campus Security Service (hereinafter - CSS). 7. entity shall perform functions as follows (via CP and ACS as needed): 1) issuing temporary permits and ID-cards; 2) withdrawing temporary permits, which are not valid as of the date of representation, as well as ID-cards of dismissed University employees; 3) check visitors` iden tification documents, as well as permits for entering University territory; 4) suspend access of a person/vehicle to University territory in case of incorrectly filled

8) maintaining technical security equipment, firefighting and fire alarm systems, TAMS and CCTV systems; 9) ensuring pass-entry system using TAMS and CCTV system; 10) maintaining material assets import/export log from/to University territory, as well as displacements within University territory; 11) video and photo recording of internal mode violations, as well as ta king relevant measures. 8. and ID-cards forms; 3) specification and submission of permits and ID-cards to approval; 4) control over fulfillment and implementation of present Rules; 5) consideration of issues, relating to implementation of present Rules, as well as issuing mandatory commissions to the Entity; 6) performing other functions in accordance with decrees of the authorized bodies/executives in order to implement present Rules. 9. Forms and types of permits and ID cards shall be approved by decision of the Executive Vice President of the University. 10. Entrance-passage procedure to/from, entry/exit University territory 11. Entrance of bodies stipulated in Annex 1 hereto to University territory shall be carried out via ACPs or points. 12. ACPs within University territory shall be set to organize access of persons and vehicles. The following access control points exist within the University: 1) ACP No. 1,2, 5,6, Turan 1, Turan 2 – for vehicles; 2) ACP No. 3, 4, Turan 1 - for pedestrians. ACPs shall be equipped with high

2 – for vehicles; 2) ACP No. 3, 4, Turan 1 - for pedestrians. ACPs shall be equipped with high -confidence communication means, lightening, toll gates, metal gates, automatic gates and remote opening systems. 13. Stands with examples of effective perm its shall be installed within ACP premises. 14. Documents providing a right for access and staying at University territory shall be issued as per the category stipulated in Annex 1 hereto. 15. Permanent permit (ID-card) grants a right for entrance and movement within the University territory as per the relevant access level. 16. In case of ID -card loss

entrance and movement within the University territory as per the relevant access level. 16. In case of ID -card loss (damage), a person shall immediately provide an explanatory note with indication of time and circumstances of its loss (damage) to: 1) employees to ACS, shall provide a relevant explanatory note agreed with the head of a structural division; 2) students to the Department of Student Affairs; 3) tenants to the Housing Department. ID- card is being blocked in TAMS, new issuance is made on a paid basis within 3 (three) working days starting with explanatory note submission and payment confirmation

issuance is made on a paid basis within 3 (three) working days starting with explanatory note submission and payment confirmation provision. 17. Entrance of University and its organizations by vehicles shall be made as per the Rules on vehicle traffic and car park regulations within the University territory. 18. It is prohibited to invite visitors on behalf of one structural division for other structural divisions. 19. ACS is entitled to request visitors` identity documents, as well as documents granting a right for visiting (if any) when entering the territory of the University. ACS employees shall pay special attention to: 1)

right for visiting (if any) when entering the territory of the University. ACS employees shall pay special attention to: 1) correspondence of the presented document with the due form (as per decree of the Government of RK dated 04.07.2013 No. 684 “On some documenting issues of population of the Republic of Kazakhstan”); 2) Document`s belonging to its bearer; 3) Document validity; 4) Presence of a relevant marking and signature of a person issued the document (if any); 5) No corrections and falsifications in the document. 20. and falsifications in the document. 20. University visitors are prohibited to import/export arms, ammunition (except for officials of law enforcement agencies for official matters), explosive, combustible, flammable substances and materials, psychoactive, narcotic and toxic matters, spearing possible threat to lives and health of humans at University objects to the University territory. 21. In case of any objects prohibited to import/export as per these Rules, ACS employees shall inform a shift boss and act as per instructions received. 22. ACS staff are strongly prohibited to accept parcels, packages, wrap pages and other objects from third parties for delivery to University and

are strongly prohibited to accept parcels, packages, wrap pages and other objects from third parties for delivery to University and its organizations employees or temporary storage. 23. ACS staff behavior shall correspond with Entity`s Code of business ethics. 4. Inside security regime observation 24. Inside security regime shall provide for conditions needed to the University and its visitors to perform their functions: 1) maintaining order in buildings and facilities within both the University territory and adjacent territory, ensuring University security and its property safety; 2) observing internal regulations, fire and anti-terrorist safety; 25. Entity, as well as heads of structural divisions and University organizations are imposed with responsibility for internal mode observation. 26. In case of need for official premise disclosure, a relevant request to be submitted to the Entity (free form) with reasons indicated therein. Official premises opening shall be carried out in presence of the employee of a concern structural division and Entity. In case of emergency, an official premise may be opened as orally agreed with the ACS shift leader with subsequent forwarding of an incident report.

official premise may be opened as orally agreed with the ACS shift leader with subsequent forwarding of an incident report. 27. Heads of structural divisions and University organizations shall be imposed responsibility for observation of internal regulations within University premises, maintenance procedure, safety measures, integrity and proper use of equipment and documents, and observing visitors reception mode. 28. A special mode shall be observed within secured premises, as well as an enhanced responsibility for its observation. 29. The following is prohibited in University buildings: 1) leave a working place with door unlocked during absence of other employees at their working

prohibited in University buildings: 1) leave a working place with door unlocked during absence of other employees at their working places, as well as leave keys in the door from outside; 2) spread smokables, smoke, use open fire including within territories adjacent to University administrative buildings; 3) make use, spread alcoholic beverages, narcotic and psychotropic substances, be in alcoholic or narcotic intoxication; 4) Block the territory, main and emergency entrances (exits), stair landings, basement and roof room premises with construction and other materials, which prevents from people, material assets and transport evacuation, prevents from fire extinguishing, as well as contributes

and other materials, which prevents from people, material assets and transport evacuation, prevents from fire extinguishing, as well as contributes to explosive devices laying; 5) Perform actions, which violate (change) established procedures of safety devices operation. 6) It is not allowed to leave official documents in passages and other unlocked premises. 5.Requirements to University premises 30. The following shall be in each University premise and on easily accessible positions: 1) Fire safety instructions; 2) A label with indicated persons in charge of fire safety; 3) Memo for employees on actions in case of emergencies. 31. Premises containing material assets shall

charge of fire safety; 3) Memo for employees on actions in case of emergencies. 31. Premises containing material assets shall be equipped with fire alarm. CCTV system may be installed in certain premises. 32. Entrance doors of official premises shall be locked to the key at the end of working day (sealed if needed). ACS employee, as well as Block manager shall have twirls stored in a special place. 33. Supervision, technical maintenance and repair works regarding University and its organizations technical systems shall be carried out by supervision and contracting organizations specialists only within business hours and with mandatory

organizations technical systems shall be carried out by supervision and contracting organizations specialists only within business hours and with mandatory accompaniment by supervised subdivision employees. 6.Cultural events implementation 34. Cultural events may be carried out in case of a relevant permit from the Executive Vice President of the University upon coordination with University services on regular basis. 35. Events carried out by third parties shall be regulated by internal regulations of the University 36. Initiator shall inform ACS on events implementation terms via e -mail in sufficient time in advance of the expected date of the event. 37. Notification shall

implementation terms via e -mail in sufficient time in advance of the expected date of the event. 37. Notification shall include event aims and tasks, venue, starting and ending time, expected number of participants, Initiator`s data, as well as information about persons in charge of public order observation during the event (position, addresses, and telephone numbers). The notification shall be accompanied with event time schedule. 38. University organizations, responsible for events implementation, shall submit a request for provision of permits to the building with indication of vehicle number and visitors` last names in a timely manner and not later than

to the building with indication of vehicle number and visitors` last names in a timely manner and not later than 1 (one) business day before the event. 39. Authorized persons (Initiators) shall inform event participants on University health and safety regulations, as well as inform about the need for medical aid organization. 40. Initiators shall clean the territory of the venue, as well as arrange furniture and facilities to their original positions upon event completion at their own expense. 41. Event initiators shall check the venue together with the ACS not later than 3 (three) business days before its starting

Event initiators shall check the venue together with the ACS not later than 3 (three) business days before its starting in order to specify its readiness level. Premises and adjacent territories must be checked with respect to explosion safety not later than 1 (one) hour before participants entering with subsequent provision of a relevant number of ACS employees. 42. Events initiators are not entitled to implement these in case of untimely request provision, in case if the request was not approved in a due manner and in case of refusal to perform an event. 43. Public events must not be

approved in a due manner and in case of refusal to perform an event. 43. Public events must not be carried out before 7 a.m. and not later than 11 p.m. (local time) in order to maintain a public order and in accordance with the legislation of RK. 44. Perso ns who violated public events organization and implementation procedure, as well as the requirements of these Rules, shall bear a personal responsibility as per the effective legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. 45. Material damage infringed to the University and its property, as well as to citizens during public event

of Kazakhstan. 45. Material damage infringed to the University and its property, as well as to citizens during public event preparation and implementation shall be compensated at Initiator`s expense and as per the procedure established by the legislation. 46. Head of ACS (depending on the event immensity and ACS employee) shall provide a relevant briefing aimed at setting tasks to the staff before events implementation. 7. Material assets export/importation procedure 47. Material assets export/importation to/from the University territory shall be carried out only based on material permits as per Annex 3 hereto and approved by the authorized persons irrespective of

carried out only based on material permits as per Annex 3 hereto and approved by the authorized persons irrespective of whether these assets are imported/exported temporary or irreversibly. Material permits are one-time permits valid within two days after issuance. 48. Material permits shall be issued against signature of authorized persons accountable for assets from the Entity and University organizations. 49. Material permits shall be issued based on invoice with a certain number indicated, and shall be signed by the accountable person and registered at ACS points. 50. Permit document shall include the name of property exported in words (clear), number

person and registered at ACS points. 50. Permit document shall include the name of property exported in words (clear), number of places, weight, height of a package. It shall be indicated “As per the way bill” in “Cargo name” column of the permit in case if several items of exported assets are listed. 51. No permits to University building with material assets under oral instruction or other ways not stipulated by these Rules are allowed. Material permits shall not grant a right for entering University buildings. 52. ACS shall maintain material assets export/import log with indication of data as follows:

a right for entering University buildings. 52. ACS shall maintain material assets export/import log with indication of data as follows: 1) last name and position of an accountable person accepting (delivering) material assets; 2) Time of material assets exportation/importation from/to University building; 3) Permit number. Material assets export/import log shall be laced, numbered and sealed. 53. Employees of the University and other organizations shall register large size objects in material assets export/import log in case of their exportation/importation from/to the building. 54. In case if any incorrectness detected in the document filled, the ACS shall suspend material assets exportation/importation, inform

building. 54. In case if any incorrectness detected in the document filled, the ACS shall suspend material assets exportation/importation, inform the head, shif t leader, and responsible officer performing material assets acceptance/delivery, and then act as per the instructions received. 8. Procedure of filling violations of access and inside security regime 55. The following refers to access and inside security regime violation: 1) attacks against University objects;attempt of unauthorized access to University facilities and territory by-passing ACP; 3) attempt of entrance via ACP without any permit or under invalid permit; 4) attempt of importation/exportation of prohibited objects; 5) attempt of

entrance via ACP without any permit or under invalid permit; 4) attempt of importation/exportation of prohibited objects; 5) attempt of importation/exportation of material assets in violation of a specified procedure; 6) vandalism, sculduggery, robbery, fights, use of alcohol and narcotics, as well as other violations as per the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan and University rules; 7) non-observance of access rules for persons, vehicles and material assets by ACS employee. 56. In case of detecting violation of access or internal mode, ACS shift leader shall inform CSS within business hours regarding its employee, student or visitor violated the rules.

internal mode, ACS shift leader shall inform CSS within business hours regarding its employee, student or visitor violated the rules. In case of emergency ACS shall inform the Head of ACS by phone. 57. ACS shall fill in an incident report form as per Annex 2 hereto. 58. The incident report form shall be attached with: 1) violator`s explanatory note regarding the subject matter; 2) objects relating to access mode violation. 59. The incident report form shall be signed by: a violator, ACS employee, and ACS shift leader. Violator`s refusal to sign the act will not result in act invalidity

a violator, ACS employee, and ACS shift leader. Violator`s refusal to sign the act will not result in act invalidity and a special note is made within the act in such case. The act together with materials and depending on violation seriousness shall be submitted to CSS or law enforcement agency for making a final decision. Copy of the act shall be stored at ACS. 9. Final provisions 60. Amendment to these Rules shall be made as per the procedure established by University internal documents. 61. Persons, who violated requirements of these Rules, shall bear responsibility as per these Rules

established by University internal documents. 61. Persons, who violated requirements of these Rules, shall bear responsibility as per these Rules and the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. 62. Issues not covered by present Rules shall be regulated as per University internal documents and the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. 63. Provision of systematic explanatory work in the University with respect to access and internal mode using local computer network, visual tools (stands, information boards) and University mass media shall be assigned to Entity and CSS.
